provenance.source: CURRENT RUNTIME MEMORY of the live MOGO page (Chrome DevTools Protocol, read-only evaluation)
provenance.note: These observations were NEVER durably persisted by the application. alexGLiveSetupStatuses has no persistence path in index.html; the Decision Event bus is memory-only and bounded.
provenance.exportTiming: Captured on 2026-08-11, after the observations were produced (campaign activated 2026-08-11T02:43:57.894Z). This is an after-the-fact recovery, not a contemporaneous record.
provenance.completenessGuarantee: NONE. Completeness cannot be independently guaranteed. alexGLiveSetupStatuses is capped at 300 entries in code (alexGRecordLiveSetupStatus truncates), so earlier observations may already have been evicted before capture. The Decision Event log is a 500-entry ring and had already wrapped.
provenance.knownArchitecturalLimitation: MOGO-012-INC-001 demonstrated the limitations of the original architecture: no durable polling or evaluation telemetry exists, so the historical record cannot be reconstructed or verified against any independent source.
provenance.isNotEquivalentTo: This export is NOT equivalent to the future MOGO-013 durable ledger. It is a one-time salvage of ephemeral state, captured with lower guarantees than the ledger is required to provide.
provenance.transformationsApplied: NONE. Values are recorded exactly as observed. No field was synthesized, defaulted, corrected, reordered or inferred.
provenance.readOnly: The capture performed only Runtime.evaluate reads. No application state was written, and the running campaign was not modified.
